name: adversarial_nearmiss
notes: produced 6 < requested 2000 despite a pool of 58549 candidate isa/locatedin facts and 60000 corrupt.generate() attempts (max_attempts_factor=30). Root cause: the eval-90k RCK KB (dim=4096, n_shards=1024) rarely returns a top-1 retrieval score >= CONFIDENT_THRESHOLD=0.15 at this fact count -- the SAME sparsity independently visible in data/sft_full.counts.json (qa_known=4 vs qa_idk=33996 for the live-KB QA generator). This is a measured property of the KB at 90k-fact scale, not a harness bug; corrupt.py's confidence gate was left untouched (reused as-is per task scope) rather than lowered to manufacture more examples.
